scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:workflow && pnpm test:database

scripts.test:workflow: TEMPORAL_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1:7233 TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE=test node --import tsx src/test-runner.ts workflow
